title: Have, Have had, Had had, Will have had

vocabulary.example: Perfect tenses add nuance to your English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: have/has + past participle: something already happened before now
had + past participle: the first of two past actions
vocabulary.example: I had had five slices before I got full.

vocabulary.meaning_en: will have + past participle: finished before a time in the future
vocabulary.example: I will have had dinner by the time you come.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the third form of a verb (had, been, gone, seen)
old, from an earlier time (and often good quality)
a short form of words (she'd = she had, we'll = we will)
the ability to speak easily and smoothly
a thin flat piece cut from something
vocabulary.example: I had two slices of bread.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a doctor cuts the body to fix something (surgery)
vocabulary.example: He had an operation on his knee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk
going to the past or the future (in stories)
vocabulary.example: Perfect tenses are like time travel.

fine_lines.title: have vs have had vs had had vs will have had
fine_lines.explanation_ar: HAVE: have = هنا والآن (Here and now). have had = حدث بالفعل قبل الآن (Already). had had = حدثان في الماضي، الأول قبل الثاني (Vintage). will have had = أقف في المستقبل وأنظر للخلف: سينتهي قبل وقت مستقبلي (End).
fine_lines.explanation_en: HAVE: have = Here and now. have had = Already happened before now. had had = Vintage: two past events, the first before the second. will have had = the End: I stand in the future and look back; it will be finished before a future time.

examples.sentence: I had had five slices of pizza before I got full.
I will have had this phone for five years by next Tuesday.

fine_lines.title: had had (full) vs 'd had (contraction)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الكتابة الرسمية نكتب had had، وفي الكلام نختصر: She'd had enough. كذلك we'll have تُنطق we'll've (يبدو صوتها مثل we'll of، لكن لا تكتب of أبدًا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: In formal writing use had had; in speech we contract: She'd had enough. Also we'll have is said "we'll've" (it sounds like "we'll of", but never write "of").

expressions.meaning_en: It happened at some time before now.
expressions.example: I have had this problem before.
After two hours of noise, she'd had enough.
I will have had dinner by the time you come to my house.
I had had a talk with my family before the operation.

grammar.title: Have: here and now (present)
grammar.explanation_ar: have/has في المضارع البسيط للملكية الآن.
grammar.explanation_en: have/has in the present simple: possession now.

grammar.title: Have had: already (present perfect)
grammar.explanation_ar: have/has + التصريف الثالث: حدث قبل الآن ولا نهتم بالوقت المحدد. نفس الفكرة مع have been / have gone / have seen.
grammar.explanation_en: have/has + past participle: it happened before now; the exact time doesn't matter. Same idea with have been / have gone / have seen.

grammar.title: Had had: vintage (past perfect)
grammar.explanation_ar: had + التصريف الثالث: حدثان في الماضي، وhad had للحدث الأول. غالبًا مع before أو when.
grammar.explanation_en: had + past participle: two past events; had had is the first one. Often with before or when.
examples: I had had four slices before I took the fifth.
I had had a conversation with my family before the operation.

grammar.title: Will have had: the end (future perfect)
grammar.explanation_ar: will have + التصريف الثالث: أقف في المستقبل وأنظر للخلف؛ الحدث سيكتمل قبل وقت مستقبلي. غالبًا مع by أو by the time.
grammar.explanation_en: will have + past participle: I stand in the future and look back; the action will be complete before a future time. Often with by or by the time.
examples: I will have had dinner by the time you come.
I will have finished this video six months before you see it.

grammar.title: Practice: time-travel with one noun
grammar.explanation_ar: خذ اسمًا بسيطًا وسافر به عبر الأزمنة: الحاضر، المضارع التام، الماضي التام، المستقبل التام.
grammar.explanation_en: Take a simple noun and travel through time: present, present perfect, past perfect, future perfect.
examples: I have had this phone for five years.
I had had my old phone for five years before I got this one.
I will have had this phone for five years by next Tuesday.

questions.question: "I ___ five slices of pizza before I got full." (first of two past events)
questions.explanation_ar: الحدث الأول في الماضي: had had.
questions.explanation_en: The first past event: had had.

questions.question: "I ___ dinner by the time you come." (future)
questions.explanation_ar: سينتهي قبل وقت مستقبلي: will have had.
questions.explanation_en: Finished before a future time: will have had.

questions.question: What is the contraction of "She had had enough"?
In HAVE, the letter E stands for ___.
Which sentence is the future perfect?
choices: I will have had this book for a year by June.

questions.question: Which is correct in writing?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نكتب of بدلًا من have.

questions.question: "Have" alone (I have a pen) is about ___.
